description: Find original synthesis kits and individually auditioned source samples by keyword, pack, BPM, key, role, review_basis and licence. project_bpm with bpm_tolerance (default 5) returns closest-tempo candidates and project_match reasons; do not combine it with bpm_min/max. Project keys need explicit mode. Optional include_unkeyed_percussion includes percussion hints with unspecified key, requiring audition; this is not proof of harmonic fit. Automated checks are not listening review. Free; no account or tokens required. Keywords match any term; read search_match.missing_terms before claiming a full match or genre. Key abbreviations such as Am are accepted; hard filters stay exact. Source tags are creator hints. Preserve attribution when required and follow each sample’s licence.

include_unkeyed_percussion.description: Project mode only: include percussion tag hints with unspecified key; audition required.

project_bpm.description: Project tempo; cannot combine with bpm_min/max.

q.description: Search sample titles, pack names and source tags.
